notes: The wiring diagram image (diagram-v1.png) was not provided; connections follow the text: OLED and DHT11 powered from 3V3, OLED on I2C (SDA/SCL = A4/A5 on the Nano form factor), DHT11 signal on D4, GND shared.

The Arduino Nano Matter and Google Nest Hub Max are not in the supplied catalogue listing, so they are defined as new part types. Nano Matter pin names/positions are approximated from the Nano form factor.

Breadboard hole positions are assumed: the Nano straddles the centre gap (left pins in row e, right pins in row f), OLED at columns 20-23 and DHT11 at columns 26-29 in the top half, with jumper wires to the power rails. Only the pins actually used are listed as joined to the breadboard.
The DHT11 NC pin is inserted but not connected to anything.
The Nest Hub Max is only a wireless Thread border router / Matter hub (commissioning over Thread), so it has no physical edge. The USB-C cable powers and programs the board.
Software steps (libraries, sketch, commissioning in the Google Home app) are not physical parts.
